## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Save failures should be surfaced before callers rely on this command: an unavailable destination currently produces a success announcement and returns zero.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Saving to a path whose parent directory does not exist discards `FileNotFoundError`, prints “Report saved,” and returns zero despite creating no report. The `except OSError: pass` also hides permission and disk-write failures; the unavailable-destination test checks no failure signal. Propagate the exception or report an actionable error and return a nonzero status, announcing success only after the write succeeds. — Users and callers receive false confirmation and cannot identify why their report was not saved.

(none)

## Strengths
- The successful-save test verifies report contents, return status, and the announced destination.
- Cleanup tests cover existing files, already absent files, and propagation of other filesystem errors.
